Figure 3:Layer-wise similarity in frozen encoders.Each entry reports the cosine similarity between CLS representations from two transformer layers, averaged over images. Consecutive layers form high-similarity regimes separated by clear transitions. RevFlow selects one representative generation target from each regime rather than traversing every encoder layer.
